Opens a color picker with three sliders and waits until the user presses OK or Cancel. Read the picked color with [RequestedRed](RequestedRed), [RequestedGreen](RequestedGreen) and [RequestedBlue](RequestedBlue). While the picker is open nothing else in the program window reacts.

```blitzbasic
;media interact dialogs/requestcolor.gif 1
;media wait 300
;media click 340 107
;media click 200 137
;media click 278 223
Graphics 480, 300, 32, 2
win   = CreateWindow("Pick", 20, 20, 240, 140, Desktop(), 3)
swatch = CreatePanel(20, 20, 100, 60, win)
If RequestColor(40, 120, 200) Then
	SetPanelColor swatch, RequestedRed(), RequestedGreen(), RequestedBlue()
EndIf
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```

![RequestColor](media/dialogs/requestcolor.gif)
@param red    Red the sliders start at, 0 to 255. Defaults to 255.
@param green  Green the sliders start at, 0 to 255. Defaults to 255.
@param blue   Blue the sliders start at, 0 to 255. Defaults to 255.
@returns 1 if the user pressed OK, 0 if the dialog was cancelled.
@gap The picker is drawn by the runtime inside the program's active window (the window of `Graphics` where there is none) and is simpler than the Windows color dialog: three sliders and a preview, no palette and no custom colors. Return confirms and Escape cancels; the mouse counts in that window only.
